Preview.Title: DAS · Combat UI — portrait preview
Preview.Empty: Control one or more tokens to see their portraits.

Bar.Checks: Ability checks, saving throws and skills
Bar.UpcastHint: Click: choose the spell level · Shift+click: system dialog
Bar.Lock: Lock the bar (freezes the icons: no moving, adding or removing)
Bar.NotOwnedItem: DAS · Combat UI: add this item to the character sheet first.
Bar.TooltipHint: Alt: details · T or middle-click: pin

Keys.CustomSlotHint: Uses the matching cell of the Custom tab. An empty cell leaves the key to the macro bar.
Keys.PinTooltipHint: Pins the detailed tooltip of the hovered cell (outside the bar, the key keeps its usual role: target).
Keys.SwapWeaponsHint: Switches to the other weapon set (while measuring, the key adds a waypoint).
Keys.BasicHint: Takes this basic action of the combat engine for the character shown in the bar.

PortraitImage.Name: Portrait image
PortraitImage.Hint: Character art (actor image) or token image. Without its own art, the token image is used.

scaleFrieze.Name: Strip size (%)
scaleFrieze.Hint: Enlarges or shrinks the initiative strip (top) on this device. With window adaptation on, this percentage applies on top of it.

scaleParty.Name: Party size (%)
scaleParty.Hint: Enlarges or shrinks the party portraits (side) on this device. With window adaptation on, this percentage applies on top of it.

scaleBar.Name: Bar size (%)
scaleBar.Hint: Enlarges or shrinks the action bar (bottom) on this device. With window adaptation on, this percentage applies on top of it.

ScaleAuto.Name: Fit size to the window
ScaleAuto.Hint: The interface grows and shrinks with the Foundry window: normal size in a 1920 × 1080 window, smaller below, larger above (60% to 200%).

FadeOpacity.Name: Opacity when not hovered (%)
FadeOpacity.Hint: The Bar, the Party and the Strip each fade to this opacity while the mouse is not over them, and come back on hover. The Bar stays opaque during your character's turn. 100%: never faded. Speed and delay follow Foundry's own interface fade (Configure UI).

EnemyHealth.Name: Creature Hit Points shown to players
EnemyHealth.Hint: What a player sees of the HP of a creature whose sheet they cannot see. The GM and owners always see exact HP.

frieze.Name: Initiative strip
frieze.Hint: Shows the turn order at the top of the screen during combat.

friezeRound.Name: Strip: round number
friezeRound.Hint: Shows "Round n" to the left of the strip.

friezeInitiativeText.Name: Initiative above heads
friezeInitiativeText.Hint: When combat begins, each token briefly shows its initiative value.

friezePrepToPlayers.Name: Strip: show setup to players
friezePrepToPlayers.Hint: Players see the strip as soon as the combat is created (to roll their initiative), not only once it has begun.

friezeEnemyInitiative.Name: Strip: creature initiative visible
friezeEnemyInitiative.Hint: Players see the initiative value of creatures they do not own.

friezeAutoSelect.Name: Strip: select the active combatant
friezeAutoSelect.Hint: Each turn, the token whose turn it is gets selected and the view centred on it. The GM selects any combatant; a player, only their own.

friezeHideDefeated.Name: Strip: remove the defeated
friezeHideDefeated.Hint: Defeated creatures disappear from the players' strip.

party.Name: Party portraits
party.Hint: Shows the party's characters in a column at the side of the screen.

partyPosition.Name: Party: side
partyPosition.Hint: Where to put the portrait column.

partyPlacement.Name: Party: placement on the left
partyPlacement.Hint: Automatic: against the screen edge, unless it would cover the scene controls (then beside them).

partyHideInCombat.Name: Party: hide in combat
partyHideInCombat.Hint: Hides the portrait column during combat (the strip is enough).

partyMembers.Name: Party: who belongs
partyMembers.Hint: Only characters assigned to players, or any character a player owns.
partyMembers.owned: Any character owned by a player

partyConnectedOnly.Name: Party: connected players only
partyConnectedOnly.Hint: Only shows characters whose player is connected.

partyCompanions.Name: Party: companions and summons
partyCompanions.Hint: Shows, in small portraits under each character, their summons and the other creatures on the scene their player owns.

partyHealthExact.Name: Party: exact Hit Points between players
partyHealthExact.Hint: Every player sees the exact HP of all party members, not only their own.

bar.Name: Action bar
bar.Hint: Shows the BG3-style action bar at the bottom of the screen for the controlled character.

barHideHotbar.Name: Bar: collapse the macro bar
barHideHotbar.Hint: Hides Foundry's macro bar when the action bar is shown.

barGMHotbar.Name: Bar: GM keeps the macro bar
barGMHotbar.Hint: On the GM's screen, Foundry's macro bar stays visible and the action bar sits above it. Players follow their own setting.

barFullTooltips.Name: Bar: detailed tooltips
barFullTooltips.Hint: Always shows the full description when hovering a cell (otherwise: hold Alt).

barLockPlayers.Name: Bar: lock for players
barLockPlayers.Hint: Players can no longer move, add or remove cells.

softPath.Name: Board: soft path
softPath.Hint: Movement path cells are drawn as soft-edged pads instead of flat colour fills. Same colours (green, yellow, red by speed).

rulerOutOfCombat.Name: Board: path out of combat
rulerOutOfCombat.Hint: Also show a moving token's path and ruler out of combat. Off: they only appear in combat. The measuring Ruler tool is not affected.

smoothMovement.Name: Board: smooth movement
smoothMovement.Hint: Tokens speed up when they set off and slow down when they arrive, over the whole path, instead of sliding at constant speed. Applies to every client.

cameraFollow.Name: Board: camera follows my token
cameraFollow.Hint: When one of your tokens moves, the view smoothly recentres on it. For the GM: the token they control and move themselves.
